section.head: Regnum Sinense
section.p: Regnum Sinense is the companion to the historical atlases of Atrium Concordiae. Every map the studio animates is drawn from the written record, and this site is where that record is laid open: year by year, the passages the maps are built on, in the original Chinese and in English translation, set side by side paragraph for paragraph, with notes on the terms, the persons and the places they name.
The reading begins in 周赧王五十九年 (256 BC), the year Qin extinguished Western Zhou, and continues forward through the Qin unification and beyond, keeping pace with the videos.

Translations are made and checked one bracket at a time against a shared glossary, so that a term is rendered the same way wherever it occurs. Names are given in pinyin with the Chinese beside them; dates are given by regnal year and converted from the sexagenary cycle to the day of the month.

section.head: Atrium Concordiae 宣和府
section.p: Atrium Concordiae is a cartography studio. Its work takes the form of animated historical atlases of China and videomaps.
Regnum Sinense is edited by Kou Shiyou, head of the studio. New years are added as the videos they accompany are released.

section.head: Contributors
section.p: 无骨者伊瓦尔 (Ivar the Boneless) is a collaborator on Regnum Sinense: the commentary and analyses that accompany each year's sources are his. He has also contributed to other historical works, among them Histodome.

section.head: How to search
section.p: The box in the bar at the top of every page searches the whole site: the Chinese texts, the English translations, the annotations and introductions, the newspaper items, the entries of the video pages, and the entries for persons, places and terms. Chinese may be typed in traditional or simplified characters; either finds the other. By default a word is matched wherever it occurs, so Lu also finds Luoyang; tick Whole words to match English by whole word only.

A year can be searched as a number — 248, 248 BC or 前248 — or by any of its reign-year names, 秦庄襄王二年 or 魏安釐王二十九年; a ruler's name, such as King Xiaocheng, lists every year of his reign. To look for a word within one year, put the year beside it: 248 蒙骜 or Lian Po 251 BC searches that year alone.

The year search covers the years of the chronology; the video pages' dated entries are found by their period (Shang) beside a word. The sources by era in the Catalogue, and the Gazetteer and Library, are reached from the Home page's sidebar and are not yet searched by year.
